title: EvilTokens Phishing Infrastructure Resurfaces After Microsoft Takedown With New Device-Code Attack Hosts
content_md: Phishing infrastructure tied to the EvilTokens kit is active again, about two months after Microsoft disrupted the service. The kit hijacks Microsoft 365 accounts by abusing the OAuth device authorization grant. Microsoft says it compromised more than 12,000 inboxes across over 10,000 organizations.
